tests.name: onboarding coach reports it is disabled on staging (read-only GET, no member data)
the coach tick refuses an untokened call (rejected probe, no write)

tests.reason: The coach writes rows and staging shares the production database, so the tick never runs on staging (409 disabled-on-staging, proven in the suite). Its rules, the shadow-only tick (writes only coach tables, sends nothing, strict exclusion), a 90-day simulation and the tick's own token enforcement are proven in vtid-04892-onboarding-coach; the migration (one touch per local day, one retry, service-role only, pacer CHECK widening) is proven over a throwaway Postgres by docs/validation/VTID-04892/pglite-onboarding-coach-check.mjs (outputs/pglite-onboarding-coach.txt). test:roles covers the new route file's atlas domain.
